pair=np.stack([(x-nxt)**2,(x+prev)**2],axis=-1)
rmse=lambda a: np.sqrt(np.mean(a*a,axis=0))
def fit(A,B,tr,te):
    return np.column_stack([A[te,j]@np.linalg.lstsq(A[tr,j],B[tr,j],rcond=None)[0] for j in range(4)])
